# Nexus v1.96.6

Tiny patch for Still Needed: Echoes with a single requested quality now show their rarity in the HUD and tooltip, using the same rarity colors as To Shed.

The fix passed the offline regression tests and was confirmed in-game on Project Ebonhold. This release retains v1.96.5's experimental sync behavior and prerelease status. The glowing-star reports are not addressed by this patch.

Close WoW, replace `Interface/AddOns/Nexus` with the `Nexus` folder from the ZIP, and keep your `WTF` folder and SavedVariables.
